editorial_review_row.content: Dukascopy is a FINMA-licensed Swiss bank scoring 7.6/10 from NAFT in 2026. True ECN execution via JForex with Swiss banking deposit protection (CHF 100,000). 20+ years of operation. Premium positioning with CHF 1,000 minimum. JForex platform not as accessible as MT4. Best for professional traders who want Swiss banking-grade security with institutional ECN access.
